(aitools.kernel.domain:define-flow (%read-text-mode context target options charset &key on-ok on-partial on-error)
                                   (declare (type function on-ok on-partial on-error))
                                   (labels ((report-error (code message &rest keys)
                                              (if (member :candidates keys)
                                                  (aitools.kernel.domain:flow-continue :on-error
                                                                                       code
                                                                                       message
                                                                                       :candidates
                                                                                       (getf keys :candidates)
                                                                                       :repairs
                                                                                       (getf keys :repairs))
                                                  (aitools.kernel.domain:flow-continue :on-error code message :repairs (getf keys :repairs))))
                                            (render (octets)
                                              (aitools.kernel.domain:flow-call (text-view/k context octets options)
                                                                               (:on-ok (fields)
                                                                                       (aitools.kernel.domain:flow-continue :on-ok
                                                                                                                            (list*
                                                                                                                             (cons "mode" "text")
                                                                                                                             (cons "path"
                                                                                                                                   (target-display-path
                                                                                                                                    target))
                                                                                                                             fields)))
                                                                               (:on-partial (fields)
                                                                                            (aitools.kernel.domain:flow-continue :on-partial
                                                                                                                                 (list*
                                                                                                                                  (cons "mode" "text")
                                                                                                                                  (cons "path"
                                                                                                                                        (target-display-path
                                                                                                                                         target))
                                                                                                                                  fields)))
                                                                               (:on-error (code message &rest keys)
                                                                                          (apply #'report-error code message keys))))
                                            (missing ()
                                              (aitools.kernel.domain:flow-call (%read-target-error/k context target nil)
                                                                               (:on-error (code message &rest keys)
                                                                                          (apply #'report-error code message keys))))
                                            (unreadable ()
                                              (aitools.kernel.domain:flow-call (%read-target-error/k context target :unreadable)
                                                                               (:on-error (code message &rest keys)
                                                                                          (apply #'report-error code message keys)))))
                                     (if charset
                                         (multiple-value-bind (octets problem) (read-target-octets context target)
                                           (if octets
                                               (render octets)
                                               (aitools.kernel.domain:flow-call (%read-target-error/k context target problem)
                                                                                (:on-error (code message &rest keys)
                                                                                           (apply #'report-error code message keys)))))
                                         (call-with-target-text/k context
                                                                  target
                                                                  :on-text
                                                                  #'render
                                                                  :on-binary
                                                                  (lambda (prefix size)
                                                                    (aitools.kernel.domain:flow-continue :on-ok (%binary-fields target prefix size)))
                                                                  :on-missing
                                                                  #'missing
                                                                  :on-unreadable
                                                                  #'unreadable))))

(aitools.kernel.domain:define-flow (%read-target-error/k context target problem &key on-error)
                                   (declare (type function on-error))
                                   (if (eq problem :unreadable)
                                       (aitools.kernel.domain:flow-continue :on-error
                                                                            "environment.io"
                                                                            (format nil
                                                                                    "file ~A cannot be read: permission denied"
                                                                                    (file-target-argument target))
                                                                            :repairs
                                                                            (list
                                                                             (repair "describe"
                                                                                     "Show the file's mode and owner to fix its permissions."
                                                                                     (command-line context
                                                                                                   (list "info" (file-target-argument target))
                                                                                                   :tx
                                                                                                   :none))))
                                       (aitools.kernel.domain:flow-continue :on-error
                                                                            "input.not-found"
                                                                            (format nil "file ~A does not exist" (file-target-argument target))
                                                                            :candidates
                                                                            (missing-path-candidates context (file-target-absolute target))
                                                                            :repairs
                                                                            (list
                                                                             (repair "find"
                                                                                     "List nearby files."
                                                                                     (command-line context
                                                                                                   (list "find"
                                                                                                         (path-basename (file-target-absolute target)))
                                                                                                   :tx
                                                                                                   :none))))))
